name: CovarianceReward
description: Compares covariance structure across features between real and generated time series. Captures cross-sectional dependence but not temporal patterns.

name: AutoCorrelationReward
description: Qualitative way to visualize and compare the autocorrelation of each spatial dimension of the real and fake time series distribution.

name: CrossCorrelationReward
description: Compares lagged cross-correlations between features and across time, capturing inter-feature temporal relationships.

name: MeanAbsDiffReward
description: Computes average L1 distance between real and generated samples. Simple marginal discrepancy measure; does not capture temporal structure.

name: HistogramReward
description: Compares the marginal distribution of real and generated data using per-time-step, per-feature histograms. Captures differences in the full univariate distribution (location, scale, skew, kurtosis) without relying on Gaussian assumptions.

name: MMDReward
description: Kernel-based discrepancy (signature MMD) comparing real and generated path distributions. Captures higher-order structure in path space.

name: SigW1Reward
description: A metric to compare real and fake time series distribution based on the path signature method. Specifically, it computes the L2 norm of the expected signature on the real and fake path distriubtion, where in theory the expected signature can fully characterise the distribution of data sequences.

name: ONNDReward
description: Outgoing Nearest Neighbour Distance assessing diversity of generated samples by comparing local neighbourhood radii.

name: ICDReward
description: Intra-Class Distance measuring dispersion within generated samples. Useful for detecting mode collapse in generative models.

name: VARReward
description: Calculates the alpha-value at risk to assess the tail distribution match of the generated data

name: EmbeddingFID
description: Frechet Inception Distance between precomputed real and fake embeddings. Replaces model-taking Predictive_FID: the task is expected to extract embeddings upstream and supply them via the evaluator context.

name: EmbeddingKID
description: Kernel Inception Distance (polynomial-kernel MMD) between precomputed real and fake embeddings. Replaces model-taking Predictive_KID.

name: MSE
description: Mean squared error between predictions and targets.

name: RMSE
description: Root mean squared error for forecasting.

name: MAE
description: Mean absolute error for forecasting tasks.

name: MAPE
description: Mean absolute percentage error.

name: DirectionalAccuracy
description: Measures the proportion of correct direction predictions.

name: SignLoss
description: Penalty for predicting the wrong direction.

name: QuantileLoss
description: Pinball loss for quantile regression. Configure the target quantile via params (default 0.5 = median).

name: CRPS
description: Continuous Ranked Probability Score for probabilistic forecasting. Requires multiple forecast samples per target, supplied via the pred_samples context key of shape [N, S, D].

name: PearsonCorrelation
description: Pearson correlation r between predicted and true vectors over the forecast window. Higher is better; range [-1, 1]. Use a positive evaluator weight to maximise.

name: SpearmanCorrelation
description: Spearman rank correlation between predictions and targets - the Information Coefficient in factor research. Robust to monotone non-linearities. Higher is better; range [-1, 1].

name: F1Score
description: Macro-F1 of binary direction classification (y_pred > threshold vs y_true > threshold). Complements DirectionalAccuracy on imbalanced regimes. Higher is better; range [0, 1].

name: R2Score
description: Coefficient of determination 1 - SS_res / SS_tot. Higher is better; range (-inf, 1]. Negative indicates worse than predicting the mean.

name: HuberLoss
description: Smooth L1/L2 hybrid: quadratic for |y_pred - y_true| <= delta, linear beyond. Robust to heavy-tailed return distributions. Lower is better.

name: SharpeRatioLoss
description: Sharpe ratio of directional strategy returns sign(y_pred) * y_true. Loss-form forecasting metric consuming aligned tensors. Higher is better. Distinct from the curated-task-only TradingReward SharpeRatio that consumes trade-history dicts.

name: SortinoRatio
description: Mean strategy return divided by downside-only standard deviation. Penalises downside risk only, unlike Sharpe. Higher is better.

name: DirectionAccuracy
description: 1.0 when predicted direction matches actual market move, 0.0 otherwise.

name: PnL
description: Signed profit-and-loss assuming a unit-size position in the predicted direction.

name: ReturnMAE
description: Mean absolute error between predicted and actual return magnitude.

name: SharpeRatio
description: Annualisation-free Sharpe ratio: mean(PnL) / std(PnL). Aggregate-only metric.

name: MaxDrawdown
description: Worst peak-to-trough decline in cumulative PnL (negative value). Aggregate-only metric.

name: WinRate
description: Fraction of trades with positive PnL. Aggregate-only metric.

name: QuantityPnL
description: PnL with explicit quantity * price-change (entry/exit with optional slippage and transaction cost). Intended for live-trading tasks.
